title: zapier expert needed fix gohighlevel demio integratio
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

Job description:
We run regular webinars and workshops. We use GoHighLevel to handle registrations and Demio to host, and the two are connected through Zapier. That connection has two problems we need solved:
Errors. Our GHL to Demio registration Zaps are throwing errors across multiple event types.
Task overuse. We're burning through our Zapier task quota far faster than our number of Zaps should allow. We suspect webhooks are double-firing (the same contact triggering twice, seconds apart), which both errors out Demio and wastes tasks.
We need someone who knows both GoHighLevel and Zapier well to find why this is happening and fix it. That likely means de-duplicating the double-triggers, cleaning up the flows wasting tasks, and moving anything into GHL's native workflows where it doesn't need Zapier at all.
What we need:
Diagnose and fix the errored GHL to Demio registration Zaps
Stop the double-firing so each contact triggers only once
Reduce task consumption so we stop maxing out our plan
Tell us plainly what was wrong and what you changed
Simplifying the workflow to keep Zap’s from overuse
You're a fit if you have:
Strong hands-on Zapier experience (webhooks, filters, multi-step, error handling), comfortable reading task history to find root causes
Real GoHighLevel experience, especially GHL to webinar-platform integrations
A track record of fixing broken or wasteful automations, not just building new ones
This is a fixed-scope, milestone-based project. If it goes well, we run more work like this regularly.
To apply:
Skip the generic pitch. In one or two lines, tell us what usually causes a Zapier account to burn task quota faster than its Zap count would suggest, and how you'd stop a webhook from double-firing.
Give one quick example of a broken automation you diagnosed and fixed, and what the real cause turned out to be.
Include the word "lighthouse" in your proposal so we know you read this fully. Proposals without it won't be reviewed.

title: n8n automation developer automated video rendering pipeline ffmpeg
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We produce long-form videos at volume. Right now the assembly is manual and it's the bottleneck.

We want an n8n workflow that renders finished videos end-to-end, unattended. You give it a topic or a row in a sheet, it comes back with a finished MP4.

The pipeline needs to:

1. Take a job in — from a Google Sheet row

2. Source footage — from two places:
- a local stock footage library (Drive folder)
- free stock APIs as fallback when the local library has no match (Pexels and Pixabay, both free for commercial use)

3. Select and sequence clips to match the script or keyword list, trim them to the right durations.

4. Composite an overlay clip on top — this is the important part. We have a branded overlay video that plays over the whole render. It has regions that are green screen/transparent, and the stock footage shows through those windows. The overlay changes at points during the video, so the pipeline has to handle multiple overlay segments in one render, not just one static layer.

5. Encode and output the final MP4 to Google Drive

6. Log and recover — every run logged, failures retried, no silent failures, no half-rendered files left behind.

Reference example of the output we want: ----------

Must have
- Self-hosted n8n — you've installed it yourself on a VPS or Docker, not just used the cloud UI
- FFmpeg from the command line — real fluency, specifically overlay, chromakey/colorkey, scale, concat, filter_complex. If you have only ever used a drag-and-drop editor, this role is not for you
- Execute Command / Code nodes in n8n — comfortable shelling out and handling stdout, exit codes, and file paths
- REST API integration — auth headers, pagination, rate limits, retries, caching
- Linux + SSH, file system handling, cron/queue basics
- Written English good enough to document what you built so someone else can maintain it

Nice to have
Chroma keying experience — knowing why despill and edge feathering matter
Alpha-channel video formats (ProRes 4444, VP9/WebM with alpha)
Hardware-accelerated encoding (NVENC / VAAPI / QSV)
Queue systems for long-running jobs (Redis, BullMQ, or n8n queue mode)
Prior work building unattended render pipelines at volume

Deliverables
Working n8n workflow, exported as JSON
All FFmpeg commands and helper scripts, commented
Setup documentation — how to install it fresh on a new machine
A short Loom walkthrough of how it works and how to change it
Handover

title: gohighlevel crm automation sales virtual assistant
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

GoHighLevel CRM, Automation & Sales Virtual Assistant

Perski Solutions is a Melbourne-based cleaning business looking for a reliable and experienced Virtual Assistant to help build and maintain our CRM, improve our sales follow-up, manage outreach, and support our online marketing.

This is not a basic data-entry position. We need someone who can take ownership of systems, keep leads organised, build practical automations, and help generate qualified business opportunities.

Position details

* Location: Remote
* Hours: [insert hours] per week
* Schedule: Flexible, with at least 3 hours of overlap with Melbourne business hours
* Pay: [insert hourly or monthly rate]
* Engagement: Long-term opportunity following a successful paid trial
* Trial period: Six weeks

Main responsibilities

GoHighLevel CRM

* Build, organise, and maintain our CRM in GoHighLevel.
* Create and manage sales pipelines, stages, contacts, opportunities, tags, custom fields, and follow-up tasks.
* Ensure all enquiries are entered into the CRM correctly.
* Keep lead records accurate and up to date.
* Monitor overdue follow-ups and make sure no lead is forgotten.
* Track lead sources, service requirements, sales activity, and outcomes.
* Create simple dashboards and weekly CRM reports.
* Document CRM processes so they are easy to understand and maintain.

Automation and Zapier

* Build and maintain GoHighLevel workflows and automations.
* Create and manage multi-step Zapier automations.
* Connect Webflow forms, GoHighLevel, Google Sheets, calendars, email, and other approved tools.
* Use Zapier Filters, Paths, Formatter, Delay, Schedule, and Webhooks where required.
* Create automatic lead notifications, follow-up tasks, reminders, and pipeline updates.
* Test all automations before activation.
* Monitor failed automations and troubleshoot errors.
* Prevent duplicate contacts, opportunities, tasks, and messages.
* Recommend when to use Zapier and when to use a native GoHighLevel workflow.

Sales outreach and lead generation

* Research suitable Melbourne businesses and decision-makers.
* Build targeted prospect lists for property managers, real estate agencies, builders, landlords, and related businesses.
* Find and verify contact information.
* Conduct personalised email and LinkedIn outreach.
* Complete regular follow-ups.
* Record all outreach activity in GoHighLevel.
* Identify interested prospects and book qualified conversations.
* Track replies, objections, follow-ups, and lost-opportunity reasons.
* Avoid spam, mass messaging, or low-quality automated outreach.

LinkedIn and social media

* Build and maintain the Perski Solutions LinkedIn company page.
* Assist with the owner’s LinkedIn profile where required.
* Create and schedule LinkedIn posts.
* Connect with relevant property and business professionals.
* Monitor messages, comments, and potential leads.
* Support other company social media accounts when required.
* Create simple branded graphics using Canva.

Webflow and SEO

* Make basic updates to our Webflow website.
* Create or edit service pages, landing pages, blog posts, and location pages.
* Check forms, links, buttons, and mobile responsiveness.
* Complete basic on-page SEO, including titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, and image alt text.
* Assist with keyword research and local SEO.
* Monitor Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
* Report website problems or opportunities for improvement.

AI tools

* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT to assist with research, content, outreach drafts, reporting, and process documentation.
* Create reusable prompts for approved business tasks.
* Review and edit all AI-generated work before it is published or sent.
* Check AI outputs for accuracy, tone, and relevance.
* Never enter confidential customer or business information into unapproved AI tools.
* Use AI to improve efficiency without replacing human judgement.

Required experience

Applicants must have practical experience with:

* GoHighLevel CRM.
* GoHighLevel pipelines and workflows.
* Zapier and multi-step Zaps.
* CRM setup, maintenance, and lead tracking.

JOB OVERVIEW

Hacking CPA LLC, a growing US CPA practice, is hiring a Marketing & Content Growth Lead to own our content and growth engine end to end -- not just post content, but track everything and turn it into real leads.

This is a long-term, full-time role (30-40 hrs/week), not a short project. You'll take raw weekly video and handle everything downstream: editing, posting, shorts, tracking performance, and reporting back with real numbers every week.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN:
- Editing and publishing across all platforms from raw weekly video
- Full content calendar execution and short-form repurposing
- GoHighLevel funnels, tagging, and automated follow-up sequences
- A weekly report: follower growth, views/watch time, engagement, top/bottom performing content, and leads attributable to content

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU:
- Real social media management experience
- Comfortable editing video for multiple short-form platforms
- Working knowledge of GoHighLevel
- Strong written English
- Someone who thinks in terms of client acquisition, not just audience size, and wants a long-term seat building something -- not a short gig

TO APPLY

title: senior software engineer backend ai pipelines ai start up
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We build agents for humans. EchoVerse Collective is an AI-native media, content and intelligence company. Our flagship product is Dispatches — a personalised daily brief about AI, written by four AI columnists and approved by a named human editor before anything ships. You can read it at ---------- /dispatches. Behind it is an agentic pipeline that researches, writes, verifies, narrates and delivers every article, adapted to each reader. Dispatches is the flagship, not the whole company: alongside it we build document-automation systems — invoice and back-office processing with human review — and other backend-heavy intelligence products. These are live products with real users, not prototypes.

We build differently. AI agents — Claude Code, Codex — are our primary instruments. We plan in written specs, fan work out to parallel agents, and review everything that ships. One engineer here has the leverage of a small team. We are hiring the second one.

THE WORK

You will be engineer #2, working directly with the lead developer and owning real workstreams end to end — from written spec to deployed, tested, monitored production code. The work is backend-first: most of your time will be in the agentic pipeline and the data layer, with full-stack work on top when a workstream reaches the surface. In a given month you might:

- Extend a Python agentic worker (FastAPI + LangGraph): pipeline stages, structured output with strict validation, verification and evidence systems, run lifecycles, cost tracking, schedulers and durable queues.
- Work the data layer: Postgres (Supabase) with row-level security — schema design, migrations, pgvector and embeddings — plus Stripe billing and webhook plumbing.
- Build document-processing flows: OCR and extraction, trust scoring, exception routing, human review surfaces.
- Build and harden features across a Next.js / React / TypeScript reader app and ops console.
- Write the tests (pytest, Vitest, Playwright), run the QA pass, and ship.

You will not be a ticket-taker. You get context-rich written specs, wide latitude in how you execute, and direct review of your work by the lead — the same bar we hold our own code to.

YOU WILL FIT IF

- You have five or more years building production software, with senior backend skills in Python and/or TypeScript — both is ideal. Typed, tested code with validation at the boundaries is a habit, not a request.
- You have real database depth. You design Postgres schemas, write migrations confidently, and understand auth and row-level-security models — not just an ORM user.
- You use agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar — as a core part of how you work, and you can explain the workflow: how you spec tasks for an agent, how you review its output, when you take over by hand, and a time it burned you. This is the most important requirement in this ad and we will test it in depth.
- You have built with LLM APIs beyond a chat wrapper: structured output, retries and fallbacks, prompt iteration, some form of eval or regression checking, cost awareness. Multi-stage pipelines or agent frameworks are a big plus.
- You have enough full-stack range to work competently in a modern React/Next.js codebase and a CI/deploy pipeline. Backend is the centre of this role, but nothing here is "not my job".
- You work well async from written specs, you say plainly what is done versus in-progress versus not started, and you never report a result you did not verify.
- You write excellent English. Most of our communication is written.

Tell us if you have any of these: LangGraph or similar pipeline frameworks; batch APIs, prompt caching and other LLM cost engineering; Supabase specifically (RLS, auth, storage); Stripe; pgvector and search tuning; eval harnesses; job schedulers and durable queues (APScheduler, Celery, Temporal); audio or video generation pipelines; Playwright or API work against poorly documented services; front-end craft.

YOU WILL NOT FIT IF

- You need a ticket queue and a detailed brief before you can start.
- Your LLM experience is a chat wrapper.
- You treat AI coding tools as autocomplete, or you ship their output unread.
- You report progress by effort rather than by verified results.

DETAILS

- PHP 150,000–220,000 per month, depending on experience. We pay at the top of the market for the right person.
- Full-time, fully remote, Philippines.
- Independent contractor, monthly invoicing, 13th-month bonus.
